name: Arena superintendent
design: Broad tall mature male with silver-grey spotted hide, large exposed tusked mandibles, high domed brow and thick black-grey dreadlocks mid-back. Rich muted gold short-sleeved official robe with three black overlapping shoulder cloth panels, large geometric bronze chest medallion, dark waist sash and long split hems. Holds a closed heavy registration folio under left arm, right hand at belt with rounded signal baton. Composed grounded posture, no king crown.
